accuracy.reason: Highest valid accuracy; accuracy-equivalent ties use lower stabilized latency then canonical configuration hash.

latency.reason: Lowest stabilized latency among candidates satisfying the accuracy-winner-relative constraint; statistically equivalent latencies use higher accuracy then canonical configuration hash.

multi_objective.reason: No distinct Pareto compromise exists in the evaluated search space. The deterministic augmented-Chebyshev fallback selected an extreme point.

purpose: Independent-allocation latency repeatability validation for the already algorithm-selected unique winner.
